name: Claude Julien Bajada
bio: Claude studies human brain organisation and develops computational neuroimaging methods in the Department of Physiology and Biochemistry at the University of Malta.
He chairs the University of Malta Magnetic Resonance Imaging Platform (UMRI), supporting MRI research, teaching and collaboration.
He is Vice-Chair of the Data Integrity and Stewardship Cluster and leads its biomedical imaging pillar. His policy work addresses research data sharing and data protection.
